responsibility: Master C declaration header for GNAT’s nontrivial OS interface layer. It defines portability macros for large-file APIs and file-stat structures, the cached file_attributes record shared with Ada code, global runtime state, and the broad set of exported __gnat_* services for files, paths, environment, process control, I/O modes, CPU affinity helpers, and other host abstractions implemented mostly in adaint.c and companion C files.
same_name_distinction: This is the declaration and portability-definition member of the adaint pair: it centralizes large-file macros, the file_attributes structure, exported globals, and prototypes for the many __gnat_* services used across the Ada runtime and tools. Unlike gcc/ada/adaint.c, it is the common interface contract rather than the platform-specific implementation body.
